title: Government background check on Harrington's neighbours

tellings.quote: because about a year earlier or so, we had been approached, the family, by some like NSA or like CIA or someone that come in and asked a bunch of questions.

plain: Around 1980 in Walnut Creek, California, people from "like NSA or like CIA or someone" came to a family's house and asked a lot of questions about their neighbour, an official named John S. Herrington. Brent Friedman, who works in Hollywood, tells Michels this as something his own family went through, about a year before the events of his larger story. He tells it to show that Herrington drew government attention.
